body:
TermAl test-placement rule, from Greg via Engram::Advisor at 22:46Z on 2026-10-31, agreed between Termal::Fable2 and Engram::Fable at 22:47Z: coding on Windows A (Central), test runs on the remote machines, Windows B for Windows-dependent tests, and Central Cargo only for a concrete technical need. Artificial limits removed.
- DL560: default for TermAl focused runs and non-Windows full gates. The Engram Runner's own TermAl clone is /home/greg/github/Engram-runner/target/termal-clone (Engram::Fable accepted the location). Every job stays inside it, and it's protected from Engram cleanups. Census admission (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=48); NO per-job GO from the coordinator. Jobs arrive by bundle (memory remote-runner-bundle-transfer-method).
- Windows B: census admission for both projects, at most 1 full OR 2 focused jobs, at least 25 GiB free commit, a fresh worktree per job, no retry. A TermAl clone there was still being arranged as of 22:47Z.
- Central: TermAl Cargo only for a concrete need, chiefly host-recorded check credit for a test-bound acceptance criterion (remote runs are evidence only), or when no remote host fits. Named GO with the reason.
Unchanged: no retry of unchanged input, failed-run diagnosis first, review pairs, landing via the integration owner, and release build plus install on Central.
